language.reference_profile: Portable Python from the official Language Reference, with CPython-specific behavior isolated into named profile constructs.

constructs.title: Source encodings and encoding declarations
gaps: Need tokenizer-level model for UTF-8 default, coding comments, invalid encodings, and BOM behavior.

constructs.title: Physical lines, logical lines, comments, and line joining
gaps: The executable seed currently requires semicolon-separated simple statements and does not model Python newline handling.

constructs.title: Indentation, tabs, formfeeds, INDENT, and DEDENT
gaps: Need explicit block token model and diagnostics for inconsistent tab/space indentation.

constructs.title: Identifiers, keywords, soft keywords, and Unicode identifier rules
k_coverage: semantics/python.k: Id token for ASCII smoke programs
gaps: Need Unicode identifier normalization and keyword/soft-keyword separation.

constructs.title: Literal tokens
k_coverage: semantics/python.k: integer, simple finite float, simple K string, True, False, and None literal subset
gaps: Need full Python string prefixes/escapes, bytes, f-strings, t-strings, full float lexical edge cases, imaginary literals, and numeric literal separators.

constructs.title: Objects, identity, type, and value
k_coverage: semantics/python.k: internal integer value subset; singleton identity subset for None/True/False
gaps: Need heap object identity, type objects, mutability, aliasing, and lifetime model beyond language singletons.

constructs.title: Standard type hierarchy
k_coverage: semantics/python.k: Int, String, list, tuple, dict, set, True, False, and None value subset
gaps: Need object identity, real bool-as-int subtype relationship, numeric tower, sequences, mappings, classes, functions, modules, and code objects.

constructs.title: Special method names and interpreter protocols
gaps: Need protocol dispatch for numeric operations, containers, calls, context managers, descriptors, and classes.

constructs.title: Descriptors and attribute access
gaps: Need object/class attribute resolution order, descriptor binding, and special-method lookup separation.

constructs.title: Generator, coroutine, and asynchronous generator objects
gaps: Need suspended frame model, send/throw/close, await protocol, and async iteration.

constructs.title: Code blocks, execution frames, and runtime context
gaps: Need module/function/class/comprehension frames and execution context.

constructs.title: Naming, binding, scopes, globals, nonlocals, and unbound names
k_coverage: semantics/python.k: single global environment with name lookup and assignment for Val
semantics/python.k: internal #namedExpr binds simple-name assignment expressions in the current environment
gaps: Need static scope analysis, local/global/nonlocal declarations, class scopes, comprehension binding behavior, closures, and annotation scopes.

constructs.title: Exceptions, propagation, and handlers
gaps: Need exception objects, traceback shape, propagation, matching, chaining, groups, and finalization.

constructs.title: Annotation scopes and lazy type aliases
gaps: Need Python 3.14 annotation scope behavior, type parameter lists, and lazy evaluation boundaries.

references.title: Python Language Reference: The import system

constructs.title: Module cache and module objects
gaps: Need module table and explicit environment profile for filesystem/package visibility.

constructs.title: Finders, loaders, specs, and import protocol
gaps: Need separation between portable import semantics and host/CPython importlib profile.

constructs.title: Packages, namespace packages, and relative imports
gaps: Need package namespace model, __path__, __package__, and relative resolution.

constructs.title: Atoms and displays
k_coverage: semantics/python.k: integer, simple string, trailing-comma list/tuple/dict/set values, adapter-backed expression display forms, True, False, None, names, and parenthesized expressions
semantics/python.k: dictionary display construction replaces an existing equal key with the later value in the supported key-equality subset
harness/python_to_k_input.py: AST adapter for the currently supported atom/display subset
gaps: Need bytes, full containers, comprehensions, yield expressions, and ellipsis.

constructs.title: Displays and comprehensions

references.title: Expressions
references.section: Displays for lists, sets and dictionaries

k_coverage: semantics/python.k: trailing-comma list, tuple, dict, set value display subset, empty container constructor values, and list(x)/tuple(x) conversion for current ordered concrete string/list/tuple/dict/range values
semantics/python.k: internal #list/#tuple/#dict/#set display forms evaluate supported element expressions left to right
semantics/python.k: supported duplicate dictionary keys keep the final value without increasing dictionary length
semantics/python.k: adapter-backed set display construction removes duplicate equal elements in the supported equality subset
harness/python_to_k_input.py: ordinary Python list/tuple/dict/nonempty set displays, no-argument container constructors, and one-argument list/tuple constructors translated to explicit internal forms
gaps: Need direct non-trailing comma parser support, unpacking, mutation, scope behavior, async comprehensions, dictionary unpacking, set-to-list/tuple conversion order profile, hashability/error behavior, and full dict/set rules.

constructs.title: Primaries: attributes, subscriptions, slicing, and calls
k_coverage: semantics/python.k: positive and negative integer indexing over string, range, and nonempty list/tuple value subset; nonzero-step slicing over string/list/tuple/range values with omitted, negative, and clamped bounds; dict key lookup subset; single-positional lambda calls; internal #call argument-list protocol for zero/multi-positional calls; internal #callKw protocol for keyword-only calls without positional arguments over current function/lambda values, including default filling; internal #callMixed protocol for mixed positional/keyword calls over current function/lambda values without starred argument unpacking or ** unpacking; internal no-argument list/tuple/dict/set and one-argument list/tuple constructor expressions over current ordered concrete iterables; internal bool() and bool(x), all(x), any(x), sum(x), sum(x, start), one-iterable min(x)/max(x), and multi-argument min(a, b, ...)/max(a, b, ...) constructor/builtin expressions for current concrete truth-value, iterable, int-like sum, and int-like min/max subsets; internal int() and int(x) constructor expressions for current int-like values; internal abs(x), divmod(x, y), two-argument pow(x, y), and nonnegative-exponent three-argument pow(x, y, mod) expressions for current int-like values, with negative two-argument pow exponents requiring a nonzero base
gaps: Need attributes, descriptor lookup, general __getitem__, zero-step diagnostics, slice objects, out-of-range IndexError behavior, KeyError behavior, *args, **kwargs, broader constructor arguments and iterable/string/base conversion, set-to-list/tuple conversion order profile, varargs, full call protocol, argument-binding diagnostics, and error behavior.

constructs.title: Await and yield expressions
gaps: Need generators, coroutines, async generators, and suspension/resumption semantics.

constructs.title: Unary, binary, matrix, shift, bitwise, and arithmetic operations
k_coverage: semantics/python.k: unary +, -, ~; integer and bool +, -, *, /, //, %, <<, >>, &, ^, |, ** with negative exponents requiring a nonzero base; int() and int(x), abs(x), divmod(x, y), two-argument pow(x, y), nonnegative-exponent three-argument pow(x, y, mod), int-like sum(x)/sum(x, start), nonempty int-like one-iterable min(x)/max(x), and int-like multi-argument min(a, b, ...)/max(a, b, ...) over the current int-like subset; string +; string/list/tuple sequence repetition with integer-like counts; list/tuple same-type concatenation; internal #floorDiv and #trueDiv adapter forms
gaps: Need zero-base negative-exponent diagnostics, matrix multiplication, string/base int conversion, exact large-int/float comparison behavior, non-integer repetition diagnostics, cross-type concatenation diagnostics, reflected/in-place methods, full type coercion behavior, error cases, and direct concrete-source testing for // once K frontend comment handling is avoided or replaced by a full parser.

constructs.title: Comparisons and Boolean operations
k_coverage: semantics/python.k: truthiness for Int/String/list/tuple/dict/set/range/True/False/None; adapter-backed bool() and bool(x) over current truth-value subset; adapter-backed all(x) and any(x) over current materialized concrete iterable subset; short-circuit and/or; not; binary int-like comparisons; adapter-backed chained comparisons over supported comparison operators; singleton identity comparisons; substring membership for strings, integer-like membership for ranges, membership for lists/tuples/sets, and dict keys; equality over Int/String/list/tuple/dict/set/range/True/False/None; string lexicographic ordering using K STRING order; list/tuple lexicographic ordering for current comparable element subset; set-to-set ordering comparisons for current concrete set values
gaps: Need rich comparison protocol, general object identity, user-defined truth-value testing via __bool__/__len__, lazy iterator truth testing and side effects for all/any, full container truthiness/equality, cross-type ordering TypeError behavior, non-set comparison TypeError behavior, and broader error behavior.

constructs.title: Conditional expressions and lambda
k_coverage: semantics/python.k: conditional expressions, single-argument lambda expressions, internal #lambdaArgs for zero/multi-positional lambdas, and internal #lambdaDefaults for positional suffix defaults evaluated when the lambda expression is evaluated
gaps: Need full lambda grammar, varargs, kwargs, closure/cell semantics for nested scopes, and broader evaluation-order tests.

constructs.title: Assignment expressions
k_coverage: semantics/python.k: internal #namedExpr simple-name target form evaluates the RHS expression, binds the value in the current environment, and yields the assigned value
harness/python_to_k_input.py: CPython AST NamedExpr nodes with simple-name targets are translated to #namedExpr
gaps: Need concrete parser integration for :=, grammar-position restrictions and diagnostics, comprehension special cases, class/function/global/nonlocal scope interactions, and invalid target diagnostics.

constructs.title: Expression statements
k_coverage: semantics/python.k: expression statement records result
gaps: Need interactive displayhook behavior and exact statement-list/newline handling.

constructs.title: Assignment statements, targets, annotations, and augmented assignment
k_coverage: semantics/python.k: single-name assignment for Val; simple-name augmented assignment for +=, -=, *=, /=, %=, **=, //=, <<=, >>=, &=, ^=, |=
semantics/python.k: internal #assignMany for adapter-backed multi-target simple-name assignment
semantics/python.k: internal #unpackAssign for flat list/tuple assignment targets over list/tuple RHS values
semantics/python.k: internal #unpackStarAssign for one starred simple-name target over current list/tuple RHS values, binding prefix, starred-rest list, and suffix targets left to right
gaps: Need nested unpacking, general iterable unpacking, attributes, subscriptions, annotations, matrix-multiplication augmented assignment, in-place/special-method dispatch, ValueError diagnostics for unpacking arity mismatch, and target evaluation order beyond simple names.

constructs.title: Assert statements
k_coverage: semantics/python.k: truthy assert succeeds, including adapter-backed optional assertion messages that are not evaluated on success
gaps: Need AssertionError construction/raising, false-assert message evaluation/attachment, __debug__, and optimization profile handling.

constructs.title: pass, del, break, continue, return, yield, and raise statements
k_coverage: semantics/python.k: pass statement and simple-name/multi-target simple-name del
semantics/python.k: break/continue abrupt-completion signals resolved by the nearest supported while loop
semantics/python.k: returnSignal resolved by the supported function-call marker
gaps: Need full del targets beyond simple names, NameError behavior, SyntaxError diagnostics for break/continue/return outside valid contexts, bare return diagnostics outside functions, yield, raise, and function/generator/exception integration.

constructs.title: import and from-import statements
gaps: Need import-system semantics and binding rules.

constructs.title: global, nonlocal, and type statements
k_coverage: semantics/python.k: module-scope single-name and multi-name global declaration no-op
gaps: Need global inside function scopes, nonlocal, parser directives, scope analysis, annotation scopes, and lazy type alias objects.

constructs.title: if, while, for, break, continue, and loop else
k_coverage: semantics/python.k: internal #if, #while, #whileElse, #for, #forElse, #forUnpack, #forUnpackElse, #forStarUnpack, and #forStarUnpackElse statement forms with explicit Block syntax; breakSignal and continueSignal abrupt-completion subset
semantics/python.k: current concrete string/list/tuple/dict values plus internal rangeVal(start, stop) and rangeVal(start, stop, step) support for #for loops, with dict loops iterating keys

harness/python_to_k_input.py: CPython AST If, While, For, Break, Continue, loop else, flat and starred sequence loop targets, and range(stop)/range(start, stop)/range(start, stop, step) adapter for the supported subset
gaps: Need direct indentation/parser support, elif provenance tests, general iterator protocol, zero-step range ValueError behavior, nested target unpacking, string and dict iterator object behavior, dictionary mutation-during-iteration behavior, SyntaxError diagnostics for break/continue outside loops, and broader abrupt completion interactions.

constructs.title: try, except, except*, else, and finally
gaps: Need exception matching, groups, cleanup ordering, and abrupt completion interactions.

constructs.title: with and async with statements
gaps: Need context manager protocol, exception suppression, multiple managers, and async context managers.

constructs.title: Structural pattern matching
gaps: Need all pattern forms, binding rollback decisions, guards, and PEP 634 underspecification triage.

constructs.title: Function definitions, decorators, parameters, defaults, and type parameters
k_coverage: semantics/python.k: functionVal(Id, Block) for one positional parameter; functionValArgs(IdItems, Block) for adapter-backed zero/multi-positional #defArgs; functionValDefaults(IdItems, ArgVals, Block) for adapter-backed positional suffix defaults evaluated at definition time; return/fallthrough call execution with environment restoration
gaps: Need full function object identity and attributes, real frames, cells and closures, global/nonlocal handling, annotation evaluation, decorators, varargs, kwargs, keyword-only parameters, positional-only parameters, type parameters, descriptors/method binding, argument-binding diagnostics, and diagnostic behavior.

constructs.title: Class definitions, metaclasses, namespaces, and decorators
gaps: Need class body execution, namespace creation, metaclass selection, MRO, descriptors, and decorators.

constructs.title: async def, async for, and async with
gaps: Need coroutine objects, await protocol, async iteration, and async context management.

constructs.title: Complete Python files
k_coverage: semantics/python.k: small semicolon-terminated program list
harness/python_to_k_input.py: ordinary Python file input for the supported AST subset
gaps: Need full file_input grammar, shebang/encoding interaction, newline handling, and EOF behavior beyond the adapter-supported subset.

constructs.title: Interactive input
gaps: Need REPL/displayhook profile and incomplete-input diagnostics.

constructs.title: Expression input for eval
gaps: Need eval-mode parsing and environment binding model.

references.title: Python Language Reference: Full Grammar specification

constructs.title: Documented PEG grammar derived from CPython parser grammar
k_coverage: semantics/python.k: seed grammar only
gaps: Need construct-preserving parser strategy: native K grammar where feasible, or parser-front-end AST that preserves every documented construct.

constructs.title: Built-in functions and constants
k_coverage: semantics/python.k: internal #range expression support for range(stop), range(start, stop), and range(start, stop, step) in for loops plus equality, integer-like membership, indexing, nonzero-step slicing, truthiness, and length
semantics/python.k: internal #len expression support for current string/container/range values
semantics/python.k: internal bool() and bool(x) expression support over the current truth-value subset
semantics/python.k: internal all(x) and any(x) expression support over current materialized string/container/range values
semantics/python.k: internal sum(x) and sum(x, start) expression support over current materialized int-like container/range values
semantics/python.k: internal one-iterable min(x) and max(x) expression support over current nonempty materialized int-like container/range values
semantics/python.k: internal multi-argument min(a, b, ...) and max(a, b, ...) expression support over current int-like values
semantics/python.k: internal int() and int(x) expression support over the current int-like subset

semantics/python.k: internal abs(x), divmod(x, y), two-argument pow(x, y), and nonnegative-exponent three-argument pow(x, y, mod) expression support over the current int-like subset, with negative two-argument pow exponents requiring a nonzero base
semantics/python.k: internal no-argument list(), tuple(), dict(), and set() constructor expressions for current empty concrete values
semantics/python.k: internal list(x) and tuple(x) constructor expressions over current ordered concrete string/list/tuple/dict/range values
gaps: Need builtins namespace, exceptions, broader constructor arguments and iterable/string/base conversion beyond current bool/int/container subsets, set-to-list/tuple conversion order profile, full object construction, full range object behavior, general __bool__/__len__/__iter__/__next__/__int__/__abs__/__divmod__/__pow__ dispatch, lazy iterator side effects for all/any/sum/min/max and constructors, modular inverse for negative-exponent three-argument pow, non-int sum starts/items, empty/default/key min/max, iteration helpers, eval/exec/open profiles, and __debug__.

constructs.title: Built-in types
k_coverage: semantics/python.k: internal integer, float, string, list, tuple, dict, set, bool, None, and range subset, including current string/list/tuple/range nonzero-step slicing, string/list/tuple repetition, string indexing, string substring membership, string ordering, string iteration in for loops, bool/all/any over the current truth-value and materialized iterable subsets, int constructor, abs, divmod, two-argument pow, nonnegative-exponent three-argument modular pow, int-like sum, nonempty one-iterable int-like min/max, and multi-argument int-like min/max with negative two-argument pow exponents requiring a nonzero base, dict key iteration in for loops, set length/truth/equality/membership/ordering including empty set(), no-argument list/tuple/dict/set constructors, list(x)/tuple(x) over current ordered concrete string/list/tuple/dict/range values, range equality, range integer-like membership, and range indexing operations
gaps: Need real object/type hierarchy, numeric tower, sequences, mappings, sets, full range type behavior, context-manager types, memoryview, and iterator protocols.

constructs.title: Built-in exceptions
gaps: Need exception hierarchy, construction, matching, traceback, exception groups, notes, and context/cause.

constructs.title: ast, tokenize, token, and keyword modules
gaps: Need explicit decision whether these are specified as library behavior, parser oracle adapters, or both.

constructs.title: importlib
gaps: Need import-system linkage and host/filesystem profile.

constructs.title: CPython diagnostics and traceback formatting
gaps: Need normalization boundaries before comparing exact SyntaxError/TypeError text.

constructs.title: CPython resource limits and implementation notes
gaps: Need profile for recursion limits, integer conversion limits, platform behavior, and implementation-defined edge cases.

constructs.title: CPython bytecode and internal interpreter behavior
gaps: Non-goal for portable semantics unless selected as a CPython implementation-profile module.
